name: ChatGPT
knownFor: The default consumer chatbot and the widest public entry point to OpenAI’s models, with a free tier plus paid Plus and Pro plans.
popCaption: 55.7% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only, not app use) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Largest public web traffic of any assistant in the Similarweb set
con: Paid-plan limits and model names change often; the $200–$500 Pro tiers are easy to overbuy
costCaption: Typical individual plan is ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, “What is ChatGPT Plus?”, checked Nov 2026). Official chatgpt.com/pricing also lists a cheaper Go plan (dollar figure not captured from that page this session) and Pro tiers at $100, $200, and $500/month (OpenAI Help, “About ChatGPT Pro tiers”). API usage is billed separately.

name: Gemini
knownFor: Google’s assistant, available as a standalone app and inside Search, Android, and Google Workspace.
popCaption: 24.2% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Second-largest web-traffic share, and it sits inside Search and Android
con: Website-visit figures under-count use that happens inside Search or the Gemini app
costCaption: Typical individual paid plan is Google AI Pro at $19.99/month (one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans and gemini.google/subscriptions, checked Nov 2026). A cheaper Google AI Plus plan is listed at $4.99/month. Google AI Ultra is $99.99/month (5x) or $199.99/month (20x). There is also a free Gemini tier.

name: Claude
knownFor: A writing- and work-oriented assistant with Claude Code included on paid plans, plus a free web app.
popCaption: 11.5% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026, up from 9.6% in September (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Fastest-growing of the large assistants in that Similarweb web-traffic set
con: Still far behind ChatGPT and Gemini on website visits; paid usage limits still apply
costCaption: Typical individual plan is Claude Pro at $20/month, or $17/month with annual billing ($200 up front) (claude.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Max is $100/month and Ultra is $200/month. API usage is separate except for monthly API credits on Max and Ultra.

name: DeepSeek
knownFor: A Chinese lab whose models lead public OpenRouter token usage, with a free consumer chat app and a separate API.
popCaption: 3.4% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb). DeepSeek V4.1 Flash variants also led OpenRouter weekly token usage in mid-November 2026 (openrouter.ai/rankings) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Leads public OpenRouter token volume, which is a real API-side signal
con: Consumer-site traffic is much smaller than ChatGPT or Gemini; OpenRouter is not the same as consumer-app use
costCaption: The consumer chat app is presented as free at chat.deepseek.com; this session did not find a required individual subscription. API usage is billed separately. Rated Free for the chat app, not for API spend.

name: Grok
knownFor: xAI’s assistant, with live web and 𝕏 search, image and video generation, and a paid X Subscription ladder shared with Cursor.
popCaption: 2.2% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Built-in live search and image/video tools in one thread
con: Website-visit share is still small; the paid ladder is bundled with Cursor, which can confuse a simple seat price
costCaption: Official x.ai/pricing (checked Nov 2026) lists the X Subscription: Plus $8/month, Premium $30/month (labeled most popular), Super $100/month, and Ultra $200/month. Rated on Premium, the plan the page marks as most popular. A free tier is also listed.

name: Microsoft Copilot
knownFor: Microsoft’s assistant, available on the web and inside Windows and Microsoft 365. Consumer paid access is sold as Microsoft 365 Premium.
popCaption: 1.1% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb). That set counts the Copilot website only and under-counts use inside Windows and Microsoft 365 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Sits where many office workers already are
con: Standalone-site traffic looks small because most use is in-product
costCaption: Official microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/pricing/individuals (checked Nov 2026) lists Microsoft 365 Premium at $19.99/month (a first-month promotional price was also shown; the band uses the regular $19.99 figure). Microsoft 365 Pro is listed at $99.99/month. There is also a free Copilot website.

name: Meta AI
knownFor: Meta’s assistant, built into Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and a standalone meta.ai site.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Meta AI is not in Similarweb’s seven-assistant website-visit set. It is widely distributed inside Meta apps, but this session did not find a comparable public visit-share figure.
pro: Distribution inside WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook is hard to ignore
con: No comparable public website-visit share was found, so the star rating is editorial
costCaption: The consumer assistant at meta.ai is presented as free with a Meta account. This session did not find a required individual paid plan for the core chat product.

name: Qwen
knownFor: Alibaba’s Qwen models and Qwen Chat, widely used in China and available as open weights and an API.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with a supporting OpenRouter signal: Qwen models appear in mid-November 2026 token rankings (for example Qwen3.8 Flash) but were not in the top ten that week (openrouter.ai/rankings) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Strong open-weight family and a real API footprint
con: No comparable Similarweb website-visit share was found for the consumer app
costCaption: Qwen Chat is presented as a free consumer app; this session did not find a required individual subscription for the core chat product. API usage is billed separately. Rated Free for the chat app.

name: Kimi
knownFor: Moonshot’s Kimi assistant, known for long-context work, with models that show up clearly on OpenRouter.
popCaption: Kimi K3.1 Pro ranked in the top ten models on OpenRouter weekly token usage in mid-November 2026 (openrouter.ai/rankings). That is API routing, not consumer-app traffic · checked Nov 2026
con: OpenRouter share is not the same as consumer-app popularity
costCaption: Kimi’s consumer app is presented with a free tier; this session did not confirm a clear public individual monthly price. Rated Free for the chat app. API usage is billed separately.

name: Z.ai (GLM)
knownFor: The consumer and API home of the GLM models, which have a large footprint on OpenRouter.
popCaption: GLM 5.3 Flash ranked around fourth on OpenRouter weekly token usage in mid-November 2026 (openrouter.ai/rankings) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Low-cost API and open GLM models
pro: High public API token volume on OpenRouter
con: Consumer-app traffic was not found in the Similarweb seven-site set
costCaption: The consumer chat product is presented with a free tier; this session did not confirm a clear public individual monthly price. Rated Free for the chat app. API usage is billed separately.

name: Mistral Le Chat
knownFor: Mistral’s consumer assistant (Le Chat) and the Mistral Pro plan, from a European open-weight lab.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Le Chat is not in Similarweb’s seven-assistant website-visit set, and Mistral models were not in the OpenRouter top ten in mid-November 2026.
pro: Clear public individual price and open-weight options
con: Much smaller public usage signal than the traffic leaders in this research pass
costCaption: Official mistral.ai/pricing (checked Nov 2026) lists Mistral Pro at $14.99/month (verified students $5.99/month). A Team plan is $24.99/user/month. There is also a free Le Chat tier. Rated on Pro.

name: Character.AI
knownFor: A consumer chat app built around character and role-play conversations rather than a single general assistant.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Character.AI is not in Similarweb’s seven-assistant website-visit set, and this session did not find a comparable current public visit-share figure.
pro: A distinct consumer audience that general assistants do not fully replace
con: No current official price or visit-share figure was captured this session
costCaption: Character.AI sells a paid c.ai+ (or equivalent) membership, but this session did not capture a current official dollar figure from the vendor’s pricing page. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual membership. Confirm the current price on character.ai.
